To fix this, I need to convert the one-hot encoded label back to a class index. I can use `tf.argmax` to find which element in the one-hot vector is 1, which will give me the class index.

The fix should be:
```python
plt.title(class_names[tf.argmax(labels[i])])
```

Or alternatively:
```python
plt.title(class_names[tf.argmax(labels[i], axis=-1)])
```
